attributes.description: Monitor and review here indicators from the Orange Cyberdefense Datalake CTI platform.

params.markdown:
This dashboard provides an overview of current indicator data ingested by the Orange Cyberdefense Datalake integration on the selected time range. Those indicators can then be used in your SOC or CSIRT scenarios, for instance with Elastic Security Indicator Match detection rules.

#### Useful links

- [Datalake website](https://datalake.cert.orangecyberdefense.com/)
- [Datalake2Elastic on GitHub](https://github.com/cert-orangecyberdefense/datalake2elastic)
